cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Let Go of the Grudge
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender resentment, distance, or a claim that keeps the relationship stuck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Let me help you move. Missing your birthday shouldn't mean I'm banned from every box.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I needed you then. You didn't show.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I know. I'm here now. Give me one thing you can bear to trust me with.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The birthday glasses. Still wrapped, since nobody came.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll carry them carefully. Could we unwrap two at your new place?

mechanism: A uses packing lessons and pupil care as the route back into a relationship frozen by A missed birthday, accepting a pointed trust test.
confusable: Not merely helping with boxes: A asks the first trusted object lead to shared use at the new home.
comparison: Physical distance at meal versus exclusion from moving and shared celebration.
seedUse: D84 missed birthday/glasses/wrapped/unwrapping; S05 taught wrapping turned mutual repair.
